scope: Compact sanitized historical evidence; no experiments rerun

studies.name: TAN-state-study
studies.outcome: DEND/POINT circuit study, not original TAN attention. Branch-versus-soma adjusted transfer was 96.45 percentage points [93.52,99.26]; matched-budget comparisons remained task-specific. A delivered-event accounting correction is retained.

studies.name: TAN-large-explore
studies.outcome: Larger h=24 circuit exploration completed 32 tuning fits, 12 new fits and 144 evaluations. Candidate-entry requirements were not all met; no confirmation claim.

studies.name: TAN-memory-transfer-20261108
studies.outcome: Restricted retraining demonstrated alternative state-dependent solutions; branch retention was not universally necessary. The initial numerical audit failure and its explicit error-propagation amendment are preserved.

studies.name: TAN-width-study-20261108
studies.outcome: Tuning stopped after 17 complete fits and one 199-update partial fit. No final training or test generation occurred in this stage.

studies.name: TAN-width-validation-20261108
studies.outcome: Width effects were nonmonotonic and recipe-confounded. The original evaluation timeout, 81 subsequent completion evaluations and separate completion protocol remain visible.

studies.name: TAN-width-step-validation-20261108
studies.outcome: Fixed-CE width-by-learning-rate comparison: h96 DEND D24 BA changed from 0% to 100% when learning rate decreased from .01 to .0025. This is a bounded optimizer intervention, not a scaling law.

studies.name: TAN-recurrence-recovery-20261108
studies.outcome: All 24 frozen models and 864 conditions were retained. Recovery-window recurrence had a causal effect in the selected h96 low-rate cohort; this did not establish complete forgetting followed by recovery, attractor counts, or original TAN attention.

studies.name: TAN-original-population-pilot-20261108
studies.outcome: The original scalar TAN cell was integrated into a population. All 12 TAN/NOATT models produced [0,0] at every tested delay, including D0. Strict BA and coverage were zero; this is recipe failure, not universal ineffectiveness.

studies.name: TAN-propagation-D0-20261108
studies.outcome: User scope correction stopped this proposal before scientific fits/calibration. Only 64 fixture timing updates had occurred; it is not a scientific negative result.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-branch-pilot-20261108
studies.outcome: DEND continuous branches received TAN-inspired history injection, not whole TAN cells. Both fixed-rate D24 FULL-minus-NOATT primary means were zero.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-temporal-select-20261108
studies.outcome: FULL-minus-NOATT primary BA differences were -25.00 and -4.82 percentage points at the two fixed rates. Opposite candidate contents allowed a temporal-XOR solution; this was not general retrieval.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-loss-control-20261108
studies.outcome: 36 fits and 14,400 updates. All eight alternative-objective primary mean differences were negative. Descriptive CE/COUNT/CECOM BA was 61.33/22.75/17.68%; count regulation increased nonzero ties.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-frozen-probes-20261108
studies.outcome: All 36 models were evaluated without neural updates. Mean t15 joint-probe BA was 83.52%, count-probe BA 63.29%, native strict BA 33.75%, and native tie-to-zero BA 57.32%. Decodability is not causal use or native performance.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-readout-path-20261109
studies.outcome: Complete t15 counterlabel state transfer changed query rasters, counts and forced native classes in 67.66%, 50.84% and 26.91% of recipients. These are different stages and denominators, not interchangeable measures.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-timing-increment-20261109
studies.outcome: At fixed two-channel counts, true temporal ordering outperformed shuffled ordering by 10.50 points [7.75,12.05] in the descriptive three-block comparison; 35/36 models had eligible pairs.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-streaming-readout-20261109
studies.outcome: Equal-dimensional MOMENT2 versus COUNT2 mean BA difference was +0.63 points with inconsistent original-block directions. These are calibrated terminal readouts, not changed neural dynamics.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-late-cue-20261109
studies.outcome: Independent candidate contents and a later selector: D16 FULL and NOATT BA were 65.62% and 81.77%, a -16.15-point mean difference across three training blocks.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-hold-paths-20261109
studies.outcome: Priority changed before preflight, freeze, scientific data generation or scientific runs. Preserve as unexecuted setup, not negative evidence.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-scale-attention-20261109
studies.outcome: Three-block D16 SCALE-minus-SCALE_MEAN mean was +3.39 points with interval spanning zero; the comparison with FULL changed several mechanisms together.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-scale-confirm-20261109
studies.outcome: 12 fresh blocks: SCALE-minus-MEAN +0.91 points [-8.79,9.11]; SCALE-minus-GAIN2 +18.49 [0.13,38.02]. The requirement that both primary differences be positive was not met.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-scale-retrieval-20261109
studies.outcome: Using the confirmation weights, trace transplantation transferred answers by +5.24 points [2.28,8.56], while dynamic versus mean cue/query reading had zero BA effect in every block.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-scale-prefix-20261109
studies.outcome: Both prefix total-effect and trace-source primary BA contrasts were exactly zero in all 12 blocks. The two boundary trace sources were numerically identical; this does not negate different-content transplantation.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-scale-training-20261109
studies.outcome: 12 fresh blocks: common-mean evaluation gave DYN-minus-MEAN -1.11 points [-6.84,2.15] and DYN-minus-DETACH +1.43 [-5.92,8.66]. Neither direction was established.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-key-binding-20261110
studies.outcome: Random write order and visible discrete addresses: KEY-minus-KEY_MEAN opposite-content BA +23.18 points [10.42,38.15]; swapped-slot counterlabel pair gain was 100 points in each of 12 blocks.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-key-amplitude-20261110
studies.outcome: Matched global injection norm: swapping direction increased counterlabel paired answers by 99.87 points [99.48,100]; correct direction versus matched mean gained 93.88 [90.62,96.22]. Per-branch amplitude/sign still changed.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-learned-key-20261110
studies.outcome: 12 blocks, 36 fits: learned bilinear matching versus uniform reading gained 52.28 points [42.71,62.37]; swapped reading gained 96.48 [91.54,99.74] counterlabel paired answers. FIFO, slots and matching form remained supplied priors.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-learned-capacity-20261111
studies.outcome: Under identical four writes, four-slot versus two-slot early-record BA gained 21.97 points [18.85,25.00]; equal-norm top-score reading versus soft reading gained 2.18 [0.55,4.23].

studies.name: DEND-TAN-learned-interference-20261111
studies.outcome: Crossing full and early-write-deleted states localized recent-record gains to native-state replacement (+10.30 points [8.61,12.00]) and a smaller value-state effect (+0.67 [0.13,1.22]).

studies.name: DEND-TAN-selective-reset-20261111
studies.outcome: Selective reset recent-record gain +4.36 points [-5.11,10.71] failed the positive-gain requirement. Early-record noninferiority passed, but both conditions were required.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-warm-reference-20261111
studies.outcome: Warm-state replacement recent-record gain +7.00 points [-4.10,13.15] failed the positive-gain requirement; a large negative tail block remained.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-donor-content-20261111
studies.outcome: With recipient input and read injection fixed, same-example versus target-bit-flipped natural donor state changed aligned count margin by 5.769 spikes [5.089,6.435]. This is a content-specific intervention, not an implementable label oracle.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-event-replay-20261111
studies.outcome: Visible-event full-prefix replay gained 10.71 recent-record BA points [7.88,13.80]; evicted-record change -0.33 [-1.30,0] met the -2-point bound. Reused weights required fresh-block confirmation.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-replay-opt-20261111
studies.outcome: Caching plus zero-row multiplication skipping reduced replay MACs by 44.15% but increased triggered-batch time by 4.738 ms and single-trigger time by .961 ms. Full-prefix replay was retained.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-replay-confirm-20261111
studies.outcome: 12 new fits, 7,200 updates, 512 examples/block and 96 paths: recent-record gain +5.27 points [3.42,7.16], evicted-record change -.13 [-.52,0]. Both frozen criteria passed.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-evicted-key-20261111
studies.outcome: Near-key competition veto: evicted-target BA +1.17 points [.52,2.02], recent BA -.03 [-.13,0]. Weights came from the replay confirmation; this was a new candidate needing independent confirmation.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-evicted-key-confirm-20261111
studies.outcome: Both original test-size budget tiers were infeasible. Zero formal fits, updates or evaluations; this directory was never silently resumed.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-shared-replay-fixture-20261111
studies.outcome: Shared execution matched separate trajectories on 2,060 input/history combinations and 27 paths, including 12 hand-designed edges. No formal confirmation or accuracy endpoint.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-shared-block-budget-20261111
studies.outcome: Both complete-block tiers exceeded frozen science/audit forecasts despite passing independent audits. No formal training or test data.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-block-optimization-20261111
studies.outcome: Packet256 and uncompressed NPZ preserved logical outputs. Uncompressed archives reduced write time at about four times compressed storage. Two rounds do not estimate host-load uncertainty.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-stored-block-preflight-20261111
studies.outcome: 512-example forecasts failed; 256-example forecasts passed (science159.10 s, audit251.30 s). Both repeated timings were retained without selecting favorable load.

studies.name: DEND-TAN-evicted-key-shared-confirm-20261111
studies.outcome: 12 new fits, 7,200 updates and 288 paths: near-key evicted BA +.78125 points [.13021,1.5625], four positive/eight zero blocks; recent change zero in all blocks. This restored legacy-replay loss to original-model BA, not lost memory content.
